messages.subject: From Path Analysis to Multilevel SEM in R -- livestreamed seminars
parts:
Hi everyone
The Institute for Statistical and Data Science (instats.com) is putting on an 8-day structured program in R, titled 'From Path Analysis to Longitudinal and Multilevel SEM in R'. This program consists of 4 separate 2-day seminars running in August that will take participants from path analysis through CFA/SEM with latent interactions and indirect effects, and then on to longitudinal SEM and multilevel SEM in lavaan. The first seminar begins Thursday 4 August, and by signing up for all 4 seminars as a structured program, participants will receive a 10% discount.

The structured program webpage provides information about each of the 4 seminars that comprise this structured program. Each of the 4 seminars has its own forum with 30 days of Q&A support along with recordings of all livestreamed sessions so that participants can engage asynchronously if this is preferred.

As always, Instats offers discounts for PhD students and weekly Office Hours that provide free stats help for anyone who is interested! You can find all of Instats's offerings here, including additional structured programs and upcoming office hours by clicking their respective tabs.

Hope to see you soon!

Mike

Michael Zyphur
Director
